# app/recommend/services.py
import math from typing import List, Dict, Any
from app.models import Camp # ✅ 这里改对了，不是 app.map.models
# 你说现在一共有 10 个 tag # 先把 tag 写死，后面如果你要和数据库同步，再改成自动读取 TAG_COLUMNS = [ "亲子", "情侣", "宠物友好", "自驾", "新手友好", "拍照出片", "安静放松", "烧烤", "玩水", "轻奢" ]
def safe_split_tags(tag_text) -> List[str]: """ 把 crowd_tags / facilities 字段拆成列表 兼容：逗号、中文逗号、斜杠、竖线、分号 """ if not tag_text: return []
text = str(tag_text).strip() if not text: return []
seps = [",", "，", "/", "|", ";", "；"] tags = [text]
for sep in seps: new_tags = [] for item in tags: new_tags.extend(item.split(sep)) tags = new_tags
return [t.strip() for t in tags if t.strip()]
def build_user_vector(selected_tags: List[str]) -> List[int]: """ 根据用户选中的 tag，构建 10 维用户向量 选中=1，未选中=0 """ selected_set = set(selected_tags or []) return [1 if tag in selected_set else 0 for tag in TAG_COLUMNS]
def build_camp_vector(camp: Camp) -> List[int]: """ 根据营地 crowd_tags 构建 10 维营地向量 """ camp_tags = safe_split_tags(camp.crowd_tags) camp_tag_set = set(camp_tags)
return [1 if tag in camp_tag_set else 0 for tag in TAG_COLUMNS]
def cosine_similarity(vec1: List[int], vec2: List[int]) -> float: """ 计算余弦相似度 """ dot = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vec1, vec2)) norm1 = math.sqrt(sum(a * a for a in vec1)) norm2 = math.sqrt(sum(b * b for b in vec2))
if norm1 == 0 or norm2 == 0: return 0.0
return dot / (norm1 * norm2)
def camp_to_dict(camp: Camp, score: float = None) -> Dict[str, Any]: """ 把 SQLAlchemy 对象转成前端可用 dict """ return { "id": camp.id, "camp_name": camp.name, "city": camp.city, "district": camp.district, "address": camp.address, "price_text": camp.price_text, "price_min": camp.price_min, "rating": camp.rating, "facilities": safe_split_tags(camp.facilities), "crowd_tags": safe_split_tags(camp.crowd_tags), "detail_url": camp.detail_url, "cover_image": camp.cover_image, "score": round(score, 4) if score is not None else None, }
def get_default_camps(limit: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: """ 默认推荐（没选标签时） 优先按 rating，其次按 price_min """ camps = ( Camp.query .order_by(Camp.rating.desc(), Camp.price_min.asc()) .limit(limit) .all() )
print("\n========== DEFAULT CAMPS ==========") for i, camp in enumerate(camps, 1): print(f"[{i}] {camp.name} | rating={camp.rating} | price_min={camp.price_min}") print("===================================\n")
return [camp_to_dict(camp) for camp in camps]
def get_personalized_camps(selected_tags: List[str], limit: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]: """ 核心：根据用户选中的 tag 做向量化 + 余弦相似度排序 """ # 1) 用户向量 user_vector = build_user_vector(selected_tags)
print("\n================ PERSONALIZED DEBUG ================") print("TAG_COLUMNS =", TAG_COLUMNS) print("selected_tags =", selected_tags) print("user_vector =", user_vector) print("===================================================\n")
# 2) 取所有营地 camps = Camp.query.all()
scored = []
# 3) 每个营地向量 + 相似度 for camp in camps: camp_tags = safe_split_tags(camp.crowd_tags) camp_vector = build_camp_vector(camp) score = cosine_similarity(user_vector, camp_vector)
print(f"--- Camp: {camp.name}") print("camp_tags =", camp_tags) print("camp_vector =", camp_vector) print("score =", round(score, 4)) print("-----------------------------------")
scored.append((camp, score))
# 4) 排序：先按 score，再按 rating，再按 price_min scored.sort( key=lambda x: ( x[1], # score x[0].rating if x[0].rating is not None else 0, -(x[0].price_min if x[0].price_min is not None else 999999) ), reverse=True )
print("\n================ SORTED RESULT TOP ================") for i, (camp, score) in enumerate(scored[:limit], 1): print( f"[{i}] {camp.name} | score={round(score, 4)} | " f"rating={camp.rating} | price_min={camp.price_min}" ) print("===================================================\n")
# 5) 返回前 limit 个 return [camp_to_dict(camp, score) for camp, score in scored[:limit]]
